title: IRA Distribution Service Guide: Deferred Fixed Annuities Required Minimum Distributions and Systematic Withdrawal Plans
content:
Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities — required minimum distributions and systematic withdrawal plans.

## Required minimum distributions

For an IRA contract whose owner has reached the federal required beginning age, Ashgrove calculates the required minimum distribution for each calendar year from the prior December 31 contract value and posts it on the contract as the required minimum distribution for the current year, with the calendar year it belongs to.

Where the tier's required minimum distribution waiver is yes (it is yes on every tier), withdrawals in the calendar year up to the posted required minimum distribution are free of surrender charge even when they exceed the free withdrawal amount. [*Retired wording, no longer in force:* "and they count toward the free withdrawal amount for the contract year".] That retired wording has been superseded by the current basis.

*Illustration (hypothetical figures).* Posted required minimum distribution for the calendar year: $6000. Withdrawals of $6000 in that calendar year are free of surrender charge under this provision even if the contract's free withdrawal amount is smaller. If $7000 is withdrawn in the calendar year, this provision covers $6000; the other $1000 is not covered by it and falls under the partial withdrawal provisions.

## Systematic withdrawal plans

- A systematic withdrawal plan pays a fixed installment of at least the tier's smallest systematic installment, at one of the frequencies offered (monthly, quarterly, semiannual or annual).
- A systematic plan change — setting up, changing or stopping a plan — is accepted only while the contract status is active, as shown on the record of the contract concerned.
- Systematic installments are withdrawals under the partial withdrawal provisions and bear the surrender charge on any part above the free amount.
- A plan stops automatically on surrender, on annuitization or on notice of death.

## Points of judgement

| Contract status on the record | Request to change a systematic plan |
|---|---|
| active | The status condition is met |
| death claim pending, surrendered, annuitized or any other status | Not accepted |

*Example (hypothetical):* a quarterly plan of $100 meets the installment minimum; a monthly plan of $90 does not.

superseded_clauses: and they count toward the free withdrawal amount for the contract year
